title: Copying a register in a probabilistic program
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program with $m$ natural-number registers, state set $\Lambda$, and oracle, and fix an input $x$ and register bound $B$. Let $dst$ and $src$ be distinct register indices. Suppose state $test$ compares them, going to $ex$ if they are equal and to $bump$ otherwise, and state $bump$ increments $dst$ and returns to $test$. For any rational $p$ and register valuation $v$ bounded by $B$ with $v(dst)\le v(src)$, if the configuration at $ex$ with $dst$ set to $v(src)$ has probabilistic semantics of acceptance probability $p$, then the configuration at $test$ with valuation $v$ has the same semantics and acceptance probability.
hypotheses_covered: The program $A$, oracle, input $x$, and bound $B$ are fixed
Every register value of $v$ is at most $B$
The specified configuration at $ex$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability $p$ under bound $B$
